overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Long OSS ETF (OSSL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of One Stop Systems, Inc. (Nasdaq: OSS), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like options and swap agreements. OSSL was launched on May 26, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
